items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: me and Chu was coming out of Teddy Hill's band

ctx.x: Was that the first time you and Chu...?

Oh, no, we... Oh, man, Chu... We spent many hours together with Teddy Hill, you know. In fact, when I came to New York, Chu and my brother was the first ones that really started beating me, because I was scared to play.
So this is after Teddy Hill.
